scope: pure Public LB literal EIP entry in laboratory, without VPC Public SNAT
observations: 24 external direct EIP requests timed out. A Public-subnet workload also timed out to the EIP.
Same external client reaches the direct Public workload. Direct Envoy endpoints return actual backend identity. These are controls, not LB acceptance.
EIP ARP reply and repeated TCP SYN were visible on ens35; no SYN-ACK in the bounded capture.
OVN NB maps the EIP to both Envoy addresses, correct Public gateway_port, and VPC router LB group.
OVN logical simulation with new-connection state reaches an Envoy logical port; this does not establish actual OVS packet delivery or return path.
boundary: No change to shared kc/Envoy processes, OVN DB, host routes/firewall, controller-owned Deployment or Pod specs. Product Delete is used to continue EIP release/rebind acceptance.
